**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

The rule was flagged as a potential "missing" clause, but § 18 contains a complete vendor insurance provision that meets the **preferred** position on every material term:

| Preferred requirement | Document (§ 18.1–18.2) |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ Exactly matched |
| Professional E&O USD 2M | ✅ Matched |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (data processors) | ✅ Matched — appropriate, as Cobalt is a hosting vendor processing Customer Data |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✅ Matched, plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra protection) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

Additional customer-favourable features beyond the preferred language: coverage runs for the term **plus one year**, policies must be from reputable insurers and primary to our insurance where customary, Vendor must give advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and insurance expressly does not limit Vendor's liabilities.

Vendor is the bound party throughout, so the clause operates entirely in our favour. No edit proposed.
